newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends up, ignores fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends up, ignores fundamentals.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended up after higher quotes from producers, despite slow response from buyers and uncertainties in Tokyo, traders said.
"The afternoon session was quiet but I believe the buyers could be returning to the market next week," said a dealer.
The sale of 1,400 tonnes of October SMR20 to Iran, at around 318 cents ($1.27) a kg, aided sentiment slightly after being announced in the morning but there was no follow-through, said dealers.
"I still see the market's upside potential more than the downside next week," said a dealer.
